findings.title: Artifact validation is a 2,255-line unchecked monolith
findings.why_it_matters: The skill's trust gate must remain locally understandable as new halt and history rules are added.
findings.what_is_wrong: validate-artifact.py owns JSON loading, registry retirement, history checks, provider attribution, checkpoint freshness, halt semantics, scorecard rules, and CLI output in one 2,255-line file, while the repository's module-size gate scans only quorum-review and peer-plan-review.
findings.leverage_impact: Every selftest that imports a gate depends on the same oversized module even though the gate families are independent.
findings.locality_impact: Each new rule edits the same hotspot and requires reasoning across unrelated registry, provider, halt, and CLI code.
findings.metric_signal: 2,255 physical lines; 25 commits in current history; the repository checker reports one hard-cap violation at 800 lines when applied to contest-refactor/scripts.
findings.why_weakens_submission: The skill enforces structural rigor on targets while exempting its own most change-prone correctness module from the same guard, increasing cross-gate regression risk.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Move existing pure checks unchanged into three private modules grouped by core schema, registry/history, and halt/runtime concerns; keep validate-artifact.py as the thin re-exporting CLI expected by selftests; add contest-refactor/scripts to the existing pre-commit module-size loop. Do not add classes, a plugin registry, or generated validators.

findings.title: Unused fixture files contract accepts paths outside the fixture
findings.why_it_matters: A deterministic fixture validator should not contain an unexercised path rule that can be satisfied by unrelated filesystem content.
findings.what_is_wrong: The optional files array is absent from every fixture.toml, yet _validate_one_fixture joins each supplied value directly to fixture_dir and checks only exists(), so absolute paths and parent traversal are accepted as declared fixture files.
evidence: contest-refactor/evals/fixtures/*/fixture.toml: no files field in the current corpus
findings.leverage_impact: No current caller receives value from the optional contract.
findings.locality_impact: Keeping it creates a new input-validation obligation inside the fixture parser without serving the current corpus.
findings.metric_signal: 0 fixture.toml files define files; 30 lines implement the dormant branch.
findings.why_weakens_submission: Dead validation code both enlarges the parser and advertises a guarantee it does not safely enforce.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Delete the optional files branch and its comment. Do not add path-normalization machinery until a real fixture needs this contract.

findings.title: Replication contract is copy-pasted across two baseline validators
findings.why_it_matters: Measured evaluation evidence is only credible when its shared artifact rules have one implementation.
findings.what_is_wrong: The advisory and principal baseline selftests independently implement the same replication-block fields, five-slot accounting, invalid-count check, floor ordering, and valid-result requirements; the clone detector reports 0.89 similarity across roughly 92 lines, while arm and contamination rules are the only material differences.
findings.leverage_impact: Both callers must understand and maintain the same low-level replication shape.
findings.locality_impact: Changing a shared replication invariant requires synchronized edits in two standalone scripts and can silently diverge.
findings.metric_signal: audit_clones.py reports similarity 0.89 across the two functions.
findings.why_weakens_submission: The evaluation layer can disagree with itself about whether recorded measurements are valid, weakening the evidence used to judge the skill.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Extract only the shared replication shape and terminal-attempt checks into one private helper used by both selftests; leave advisory arm selection and principal contamination/retry policies local.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: Split the validator without changing gate behavior so the existing Shallow module failure is removed and the repository's 800-line policy covers this skill.
simplification_check.helpful_simplification: Delete the unused files branch; later consolidate only the genuinely shared replication assertions.
simplification_check.should_not_be_done: Do not build a validator class hierarchy, gate plugin registry, code generator, or generic path-sandbox abstraction.
simplification_check.tests_after_fix: Keep the existing 31 standalone selftests and strict fixture/smoke runs; add no parallel replacement suite. Run the existing module-size checker against contest-refactor/scripts.

deepening_candidates.why_shallow_or_misplaced: One importable script exposes unrelated schema, history, provider, checkpoint, and halt policies through a single file.

deepening_candidates.test_surface_after_change: Existing gate selftests import the compatibility surface; validate-fixtures and smoke exercise the CLI.
deepening_candidates.smallest_first_step: Move the registry/history checks as a behavior-preserving slice, then move the remaining families until every module is below 800 lines.
deepening_candidates.what_not_to_do: Do not introduce gate objects, registration decorators, or generated code.

deepening_candidates.source_friction_proven: Finding F3: two measured-baseline validators carry a 0.89-similar replication check.
deepening_candidates.why_shallow_or_misplaced: Shared attempt-shape rules live in each caller instead of one named helper, while caller-specific policies are interleaved with them.
deepening_candidates.behavior_to_move_behind_interface: Centralize required fields, terminal-slot selection, invalid counts, and valid-result presence; return failure strings to each caller.
deepening_candidates.test_surface_after_change: _advisory_baseline_selftest.py and _principal_baseline_selftest.py remain the two interface-level consumers.
deepening_candidates.smallest_first_step: Extract the byte-for-byte common assertions and keep every divergent rule local.
deepening_candidates.what_not_to_do: Do not merge the two baseline formats or invent a generalized evaluation framework.

loops.narrative: Place, not win. The baseline is green and runtime state ownership is mostly trustworthy, but the skill's central trust gate is an unenforced 2,255-line hotspot and the evaluation layer retains avoidable dead and duplicated validation. Concurrency risk is low in these sequential CLIs; tests reduce regressions strongly but miss the module-policy and dormant-path gaps. The next change should be a mechanical split, not a new validation framework.
